user_story: As a user, I want to register with the maximum allowed name length so that long names are handled correctly.

positive.title: Register with maximum allowed name length using valid characters
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length using valid characters
positive.expected_result: User should be registered successfully and see a welcome message.

positive.title: Register with maximum allowed name length using mixed case
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length using mixed case characters
positive.expected_result: User should be registered successfully and see a welcome message.

negative.title: Register with a name exceeding the maximum allowed length
steps: Enter a name exceeding the maximum allowed length
negative.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating the name is too long.

negative.title: Register with an empty name field
negative.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the name field is required.

edge.title: Register with name that has special characters at the maximum length
steps: Enter a name with the maximum allowed length containing special characters
edge.expected_result: User should be registered successfully and see a welcome message if special characters are allowed.

edge.title: Register with name consisting of spaces at the maximum allowed length
steps: Enter a name consisting solely of spaces at the maximum allowed length
edge.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating that the name cannot consist solely of spaces.
